en:
The cause of the error that affected
Gonta's avatar...

...is the <CLT=cltSTRONG>two cords<CLT=cltNORMAL> on the helmet used
to log in to the Virtual World.

Put the red <CLT=cltSTRONG>consciousness<CLT=cltNORMAL> cord in the right
port, and the blue <CLT=cltSTRONG>memory<CLT=cltNORMAL> cord in the left.

Out of curiosity...what happens if you
switch the cords?

I dunno. I've never done that before...
Probably gets all glitchy or something!

I think that Gonta messed up something
with the cords, causing the error.

If he mixed the <CLT=cltSTRONG>consciousness<CLT=cltNORMAL> and <CLT=cltSTRONG>memory<CLT=cltNORMAL>
cords, then there'd be an error with <CLT=cltSTRONG>memory<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Like...an error that won't let you bring your
avatar's memories to the real world...
Wh-What!?

Gonta, do you think it's possible that you
improperly connected the cords?

Huh? How Gonta supposed to remember
that...?

H-He couldn't have messed it up!
I said it over and over!

Right is the hand you hold your
chopsticks in!
Oh, but Gonta hold chopsticks with this hand...
Nyeh!? Th-That's your left hand!
Whaaaat!?

Ah-hahahaha!
Looks like it's decided!
What's...decided?

He's wrong, isn't he Gonta? You 
remember the Virtual World, don't you?
G-Gonta not remember...

Gonta not even go to this "<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ver-chew-ul World<CLT=cltNORMAL>"
place...
What...?
Gonta fall asleep when he put helmet on...

When Gonta wake up...Miu dead...
Gonta not know what happened...

So...Gonta worry. Gonta not understand
what everyone talking about...
No...! It can't be!

But Gonta try his best to understand.
Gonta imagine real hard—
That's enough, Gonta. We already know.
Kn-Know what...?

We know that you totally forgot about 
teaming up with me...and killing Miu.

W-Wait a minute! That lie!
Gonta not kill Miu!
Cuz...why would Gonta do that!?

Yeah, it's a lie!
I'll never accept this!

And besides!
Gonta's got no motive to kill Miu!

...I already gave you my testimony on
how I came up with the murder plan.
And I'm saying I don't believe you!

Kokichi, if what you're saying is true,
why did you plan it this way?

You wanted to plan the murder yourself,
but have someone else carry it out?

Is the person who planned it also included
as a blackened with the perpetrator?

Nope! Only the person who actually commits
the murder becomes the blackened!

Then there's no incentive to just
plan the murder...

But Gonta's such a gentle soul.
Why would he agree to this?
Hold on! That hasn't been decided yet!

Who cares about the <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL>?
Let's vote for the culprit already.
I care about the motive!

Well, I don't care. <CLT=cltSTRONG>Finding the culprit<CLT=cltNORMAL> is more 
important in this class trial.

Talking about the motive is meaningless.
It's not necessary for this specific case.

No matter what you say...
I'll never believe your lies.

We all agree that Gonta is the culprit, right?
It would be <CLT=cltSTRONG>impossible<CLT=cltNORMAL> for anyone but him.
Impossible? Why?

It's pretty obvious if you use 
the process of elimination...

Which meeeeans—Shuichi! 
You'll be my partner, right!?
<CLT=cltMIND>...Me?

Because if you don't face the truth
then we'll all die, riiiiight?
And you don't want that, do you?
O-kaaay! Let's begin!

Quit screwing around! I'm done putting up
with your selfish bullshit!

Kaito, we should listen to his explanation.
Our lives depend on it.
Grh...

Sooo, we can now take Kee-boy, Himiko, 
and Maki off the suspect list...

Shuichi, would you care to explain?
I doubt they'll believe it if it came from me.

<CLT=cltMIND>The reason Keebo, Himiko, and Maki
can be eliminated as suspects is because...
They didn't have the murder weapon
They didn't have the murder weapon—

There weren't any conventional murder
weapons in the Virtual World, right?

So it's not that... you gotta remember 
what you deducted up until now, Shuichi.

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to face the truth...
Everyone's lives are on the line!
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
They couldn't access the crime scene
They didn't have a motive
They didn't have a motive—
Don't give us such a vague answer.

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to face the truth...
Everyone's lives are on the line!
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Why are you so quiet?
Explain what you came up with so far!

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to face the truth...
Everyone's lives are on the line!
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>The reason Keebo, Himiko, and Maki
can be eliminated as suspects is because...

They <CLT=cltSTRONG>couldn't get to the crime scene<CLT=cltNORMAL>,
could they?

The bridge from the chapel to the mansion was
gone, and only Miu could pass through the wall.

The three at the chapel had no way to get to
the mansion, so they couldn't have done it.

Kaito is the next one off our suspect list.
And you know why, right?
He was logged out
He didn't go to the roof
Kaito didn't go to the roof—

That doesn't matter either way.
It's waaay more basic than that.

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to face the truth...
Everyone's lives are on the line!
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
He wouldn't kill anybody
Kaito wouldn't kill—

C'mon... Are you really saying this in a killing
game where betrayal is expected?

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to face the truth...
Everyone's lives are on the line!
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Miu used the cell phone on...Kaito...
You know where I'm going with this, right?

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to face the truth...
Everyone's lives are on the line!
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
<CLT=cltMIND>The reason why Kaito isn't a suspect...
Kaito had <CLT=cltSTRONG>logged out<CLT=cltNORMAL> ahead of us...
Miu logged Kaito out from the start...

But she did that to make us think the
murder happened in the real world, right?

Since we figured out the actual killing
happened in the Virtual World...

...it would've been impossible for Kaito,
who had already logged out.

Miu's time of death was around <CLT=cltSTRONG>6:30 in the
morning<CLT=cltNORMAL>. That's after Kaito logged out.

Nyeeeh... Kokichi's completely
running the show now.

My synergy with Shuichi is super on point now,
so let's move on to the remaining suspects.

Gonta, Tsumugi, Shuichi, and me...
Tsumugi and Shuichi can be crossed off.
But what's the reason for that?
We didn't go to the roof

Tsumugi and I didn't go to the roof
while we were searching the area...

Well, that is true.
But it's not that.

What were you two doing when the
incident happened?

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to face the truth...
Everyone's lives are on the line!
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
We have solid alibis
We saw Miu
We saw Miu at the mansion...

Non, non... Tsumugi was the only one
who saw that...

If you had seen that, then it would've
been possible for you to be the culprit!

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to face the truth...
Everyone's lives are on the line!
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Are you uncomfortable talking about yourself?
Why are you quiet?

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to face the truth...
Everyone's lives are on the line!
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>The reason why Tsumugi and I
can't be the culprit is...

Tsumugi and I are witnesses to each other's
alibis.

Both of you heard Miu hitting the chapel wall,
right?

The culprit was definitely on the roof 
during that time, since they slid Miu down.

Because of that, Shuichi and Tsumugi
can't be the culprit.

That leaves only Gonta and me as the
remaining suspects...
Then you're the culprit!

Sorry for getting your hopes up, but didn't
I already explain that's impossible?
Kokichi didn't go to the roof
Kokichi didn't go to the roof, so—

Ah-haha...what are you saying?
You already refuted that before, didn't you?

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to face the truth...
Everyone's lives are on the line!
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Kokichi was Miu's target
Kokichi was Miu's target, so—

Yeah, that's true.
But there's a clearer reason regarding that.

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to face the truth...
Everyone's lives are on the line!
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
He couldn't have killed Miu

What's wrong?
We just talked about it!

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to face the truth...
Everyone's lives are on the line!
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>The reason why Kokichi
can't be the culprit is...

<CLT=cltSTRONG>If Miu touched him, he'd freeze in place<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Kokichi wasn't capable of strangling her.

So then, it's down to one person.
Aaaand...who was that again?
Uh... Uhhh...
Weeeell? Who is it?

Don't answer, Shuichi!
You don't need to answer that!
This is all Kokichi's trap!

<CLT=cltMIND>There's only one suspect left.
Only one person could have done this...

C'mon, already.
We just said it couldn't be me.

You're pretty stubborn, Shuichi.
And you call yourself a detective?

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to face the truth...
Everyone's lives are on the line!
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Keeping your mouth shut isn't gonna help.
C'mon! Shove it in everyone's faces already!
The truth that everyone adores so much!

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to face the truth...
Everyone's lives are on the line!
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

You can't say that after coming all this way.
There's only one person who could've done it.

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to face the truth...
Everyone's lives are on the line!
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Who is the only person who could
have committed this murder?
I-It's...it's...Gonta.
Sh-Shuichi!?

Yup! Gonta is the only person who 
could've committed the murder!

You get it now, right? That's the truth
we were all reaching for.

The thing you guys wanted so badly!
A truth without any lies!
Miu Iruma's killer...is Gonta Gokuhara!

R-Really...?
Did Gonta...really do it...?

Geeeez, is that really your reaction?
It would've been fun if you went all crazy.
...But you forgot everything. So, oh well.

A culprit who can't remember their murder
is pretty interesting, so better than nothing.

If Gonta remembered, his cover would've been
blown so fast. Especially since he's an idiot.

H-Hold on! I-I still haven't accepted this!
This has gotta be...Kokichi's trap...

I still believe in Gonta!
He's not the kinda person who'd kill!
Kaito...

I already said this a million times, Kaito.
You shouldn't use emotions to re—
You want proof!? I've got your proof!
...Huh?

After Tsumugi and Shuichi heard Keebo's 
voice in the mansion, they ran outside.
And who did they see out there?
Oh! Shuichi and Tsumugi!

Gonta, did you see Keebo around
here anywhere?
N-No, Gonta not see him.
Gonta.
Kokichi said it himself...

When Miu's avatar crashed into the chapel 
wall, the culprit musta been on the roof.

I see! If Gonta's the culprit, it'd be
weird if he wasn't on the roof!

It's possible that he fled the mansion after
he heard the impact...

You'd have to go through the entrance hall
to get outside the mansion from the roof.

Is that where Shuichi and Tsumugi ran to
when they heard the crashing sound?
Then maybe he jumped off the roof?

That's not possible!
That rooftop was pretty high up!

Normally, Gonta could've done it, but his
avatar wasn't strong enough.
How about that!? Now you get it, right!?

If Gonta was the culprit, there's no way
he coulda been outside the mansion!

Now you can't say Gonta's the culprit!
Congrats, Gonta!
What!? Really!?

<CLT=cltMIND>It would have been so
nice if that were the truth...

<CLT=cltMIND>If Kaito were right, and this horrible
trial would just end...
<CLT=cltMIND>But...
No...that's wrong...
What?

Just because Gonta was at the mansion
doesn't mean that he isn't the culprit.

All the culprit needed was a way to get
from the roof to outside the mansion.
...Huh?

Nee-heeheehee... Looks like Shuichi got it.
I'll leave the rest to him.

Kaito, I know how you feel. I know
because we all feel it.
But...we have to face the truth.

No matter how cruel that truth may be,
we *need* to face it...to survive.
Whose side are you on, Shuichi?
Kaito, please!

Aren't you my sidekick!?
Was that...just a lie!?
Kaito!

Fine then! I'll tear that sorry reasoning 
of yours apart and wake you up!

<CLT=cltMIND>I can't doubt my
detective work now.

<CLT=cltMIND>If I want us all to survive,
I can't back down!
